LESSON: MY FAMILY FAMILY MEMBERS

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Creation
Topic 1.4: My Family Family members

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about My Family Family members. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why is it important to know members of your family?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. name family members in the nuclear and extended family,
2. draw a family tree to understand relationships within the family,
3. explain why it is important to honour parents,
4. respect family members for harmonious co- existence. The learner is guided to: relationships, family, family (cousins, aunts, uncles, grandparents), family members on it, respect for family members, eating or praying together, parents. 5. take care when alone with people of the opposite sex,
6. mention ways of protecting oneself from sexual abuse,

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about My Family Family members.
2. Explain My Family Family members to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: sing a song related to family relationships,
4. Show that you can: name family members in the nuclear and extended family,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about My Family Family members. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is it important to know members of your family?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Sing a song related to family relationships,
2. Draw a family tree and write names of family members on it,
3. List ways of respecting family members,
4. Type a poem using a digital device about respect for family members,

SECTION 8: REMEMBER
